source: 2018/TSB Vol 18 No 14 - New Turbo Mister Demo Kit.pdf
title: Demo Kit for the Universal Turbo Mister Adapter
lead: MOC's new demo kit allows you to visually see the complete atomization/mist of the Universal Turbo Misting adapter (under vacuum) while used in connection with the EDR-3 Fuel Service Machine or Module. This new kit is Part No. 71381. Demonstration procedure instructions are included with each kit.
